rationale.campaign_length: 55个直接任务横跨早期征服、中期整合、后期考古与帝国危机，属于长战役。
rationale.colonization: 德万、昌德雅和伊菲莱方向包含定居、边界安排与丛林前沿，但不是传统海外殖民国。
rationale.complexity: 战争、附庸、文化宗教、政治滑杆、考古与灾难并行，资源和时序要求高。
rationale.dark_story: 文明复兴包装下包含强制同化、劳役、土地剥夺和帝国内战，但不以无差别毁灭为目标。
rationale.difficulty: 强力开局降低生存难度，君主点压力、多方向战争和后期大陆内战显著提高完成难度。
rationale.diplomacy: 厄卡忒联盟、刻伊翁城邦、谟忒巴耳和多类属国要求长期管理关系与独立倾向。
rationale.early_pressure: 拉斯卡里斯极强，但有限寿命和任务节奏鼓励玩家不断作战，慢打会失去优势。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 先驱考古、遗迹、塔塞尼、魔法木材和特殊战舰构成完整技术探索线。
rationale.narrative_density: 预言死期、两位英雄、继承危机、文明工程、考古狂热和君主派内战连续推进。
rationale.tall_play: 城市、地方首府、遗迹和塔塞尼建设重要，但服务于大陆帝国而非纯种田。
rationale.trade_economy: 海权、港口、自由港与东西贸易支撑帝国财政，重要但不压过战争和治理。
rationale.warfare: 拉斯卡里斯倒计时、泰琴德统一、地区霸权和内战要求持续且规模不断扩大的战争。

identity.appearance: 1444年安布亨刻伊翁主义共和国；君主派内战中可切换为G00那居拉并继续同一任务树

successors.relationship: 后期君主派内战的可选玩家阵营；与G52共享全部55个任务，胜者继续同一战役链

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
在很长一段时间里，阿墨翁处于孤立状态，专注于建立一座配得上自己的首都，并缓慢向周边殖民。在那个时代，我们只不过是一个被世界遗忘的边缘国家。

当拉斯卡里斯出现时，情况发生了变化。他是一位强大的精灵，也是才华横溢的演讲家，得知了自己命定的死亡之时——并看到了另一面：在那个时刻到来之前，他事实上是永生不死的。利用这一点，拉斯卡里斯登上了阿墨翁的领袖之位，重组了陆军和海军，并带领他们走上了横贯泰琴德的征服之路；他的最终目标是夺取泰琴德的宝石——刻伊俄奈语中的那居拉，那宏伟的大纳加尔雄城。

拉斯卡里斯胜了又胜，最终令我们成功在泰琴德站稳脚跟，彰显自己的存在，但还有很多事情要做。即使当下，叛乱分子和不轨军阀们仍旧在密谋反对我们；四处环伺的群狼威胁着要把我们再度推回大海。但这永远不会发生，拉斯卡里斯之梦总有一天会成为现实，届时全泰琴德都将在我们的统治之下拜服！
description.text_en:
For a long time Ameion was in isolation, focused on building a worthy capital and slowly colonizing its surroundings. In that age, we were nothing more than a peripheral state; forgotten to the world.

This all changed with the rise of Laskaris, a mighty elf and a brilliant speaker, who learned the time of his demise, effectively giving him immortality before his deathday. Using this, he got himself elected and became the leader of Ameion. He renovated the army and navy, and led them on a path of conquest through Taychend; his ultimate goal being the seizure of the jewel of Taychend, the great city of Nanru Nakar, Nákyra in Kheionai.

His victories gave us a presence in Taychend, but there is still much to be done. Even now, rebels and warlords conspire against us; threatening to push us back into the sea. But this will never occur, for one day Laskaris’ dream will be realized, and all of Taychend will fall under our dominion.

description.text:
许多世纪前，一场运动在涅刻伊斯兴起，他们密谋赶走亚历坎德的统治者，在德万建立一个由城市组成的伟大王国。在随后的战争中，这些英雄被打败，被追赶到已知世界的边缘。疲惫不堪的他们最终在一条汇入大海的大河附近定居下来，这个定居点最终发展成为一座宏伟的城市，我们称之为阿墨翁。

最后，我们与西方的表亲重新建立了联系。虽然我们之间仍有许多恩怨，但为了谨慎起见，我们还是应该修补这些旧伤。我们的外交官一直在缓慢但稳步地恢复与其他城市的联系，并在此过程中学会了许多安抚其领导人的技巧。
description.text_en:
Many centuries ago a movement grew among the Nékheis, conspiring to kick out their Alecandi overlords and establish a great kingdom of cities in Devand. The subsequent war that followed would see these heroes defeated, chased to the edge of the known world. Tired and exhausted, they finally settled down near where a great river emptied into the sea, and this settlement would eventually grow into a grand city; known to us as Ameion.

At last, we re-established contact with our cousins to the west. Although much bad blood remains between us, it is prudent that we mend these old wounds. Our diplomats have been slowly but steadily restoring ties with the other Kheions, learning many tricks to appease their leaders in the process.

description.text:
泰琴德遗迹精灵是一个奇怪的民族，与我们如此相似，却又如此不同。他们住在城邦里，却向君主屈膝。他们从事农业，但也觉得有必要不断掠夺对方的土地。他们出产伟大的哲学家和作家，却把死去的统治者奉若神明。

他们的历史是悲剧性的，冲突、巩固和崩溃不断循环；自厄利菲以来不断重复，最后只剩下痛苦和混乱。在泰琴德遗迹精灵看来，我们不过是一连串试图统治这片土地的征服者中的某一个。

我们的哲学家已经确定，泰琴德遗迹精灵的信仰体系，即对神化的英雄与国王的信仰体系，才是泰琴德痛苦的根源。我们将实施一项伟大的计划，将泰琴德之民「刻伊俄奈化」。通过教育、政策和通婚，泰琴德遗迹精灵将变得文明开化；军阀混战的循环将在刻伊俄奈的指导下走向终结。
description.text_en:
The Taychendi are an odd people, so similar, yet so distinct from our own. They live in city states, yet bend the knee to monarchs. They practice agriculture, yet also feel the need to raid eachother’s lands constantly. They produce great philosophers and writers, yet worship dead rulers as gods.

Their history is tragic, a constant cycle of conflict, consolidation, and collapse; repeating continuously since the Erriphi and bringing only suffering and chaos in its wake. As far as the Taychendi are concerned, we are merely the next in a long series of conquerors seeking to rule Taychend.

Our philosophers have determined that it is the Taychendi belief system, that of god-heroes and divine kings, that is the source of Taychend’s misery. We will institute a great program to "Kheionize" the Taychendi. By education, policies, and intermarriage, the Taychendi will become properly civilized; and the cycle of warlordism will meet its end under Kheionai guidance.

description.text: 福提斯特瑞珀制度是为进一步推动泰琴德遗迹精灵的刻伊俄奈化而推出的政策之一。在阿墨翁军队中服役的泰琴德士兵如果自愿接受刻伊俄奈文化并完成刻伊俄奈化，就能从阿谟布恩管理者那里获得土地和特权；这些土地和特权通常是从不忠诚的泰琴德贵族和农民那里夺取的。这些被称为福提斯特瑞珀的士兵，组成了一支忠诚的本地常备军，将自己的存亡和地位与阿墨翁帝国的兴衰紧密相连。福提斯特瑞珀之后成为16世纪发展起来的新兴克莱雷延文化的核心群体之一，对克莱雷延在阿墨翁社会中的崛起起到了重要作用。
description.text_en: One of the policies introduced to further the Kheionization of the Taychendi was the Fotistrépei System. Taychendi soldiers serving in the Ameioni army, who willingly adopted Kheionai culture and became Kheionized, would receive land and privileges from Ambhen administrators; which were often seized from disloyal Taychendi nobility and peasantry. These soldiers, known as Fotistrépei, formed a permanent and loyal native force, whose existence and status was tied to the success of the Ameioni Empire. The Fotistrépei would form one of the core groups of the emerging Klereyen culture that developed in the 1500s and were instrumental in the rise of the Klereyen within Ameioni society.

effects.display: 正统信仰省份提供的人力：+20%
effects.label_zh: 正统信仰省份提供的人力

description.text:
在我们的祖先被流放后的岁月里，他们经历了无数艰难困苦，从一无所有中建立起一个社会。他们被迫利用仅有的资源建立一个正常运转和稳定的国家，与涅刻伊斯不同的是，他们没有来自西方表亲的援助。

在这段与世隔绝的黑暗时期形成的各种制度中，厄斯福拉特制度最为严苛。尽管非常严格，但它却是一个运行高效的、先进的劳力和资源管理系统，其创始宗旨在于确保所有人都能为定居点的生存贡献自己的力量。随着时间的推移，随着与世界其他地区贸易联系的重新建立，对这一制度的需求逐渐消失，它也就被抛弃了。

随着我们对泰琴德的统治逐渐稳固，我们的许多官员开始从过去的经验中寻找灵感，以解决目前泰琴德遗迹精灵不合作的问题。现在是时候重新引入厄斯福拉特了，因为只有通过这样严厉的制度才能迫使泰琴德遗迹精灵为我们的帝国做出应有的贡献。
description.text_en:
In the years following the exile of our ancestors, they underwent numerous hardships building a society from nothingness. They were forced to create a functioning and stable state with what few resources they had and, unlike the Nékheis, had no aid from our cousins to the west.

Of the systems that developed during this dark period of isolation, Eisphoráth was the harshest. Disregarding its strictness, it was a well run and advanced system of labor and resource management, invented to ensure all contributed their dues to ensure the survival of the settlement. This system was abandoned over time, as the need for it disappeared with the reestablishment of trade links to the rest of the world.

As our consolidation of Taychend continues, many of our officials have begun to look to the past for inspiration to solve our current issues with the Taychendi not cooperating. It is about time we reintroduce the Eisphoráth, for only with a harsh system like this will the Taychendi be coerced into properly contributing to our empire.

description.text: 阿弥托利是一系列防御工事，用来镇压一直隐藏在泰琴德各个山丘中的叛军。由于建在战略位置，不仅提供了强大的防御能力，而且便于连接补给线和援军，阿弥托利一直保持着完美的状态。
description.text_en: The Ýmytolí are a series of fortifications created to repress the ever present rebels that hide among the various hills of Taychend. Built in strategic positions that not only offer great defensiveness but also easy access to supply lines and reinforcements, the Ýmytolí are always kept in perfect condition.

description.text:
起初只有几艘船。一小队船只，是来自埃兰提尔以外遥远大陆的探险者。但是，涓涓细流变成了滔滔洪水，各种肤色和体型的异族人挤满了我们在泰琴德的港口，试图偷走我们祖先的珍贵文物。

起初，我们选择容忍。但很快，地方官员就开始对他们的行动和影响施加限制。当我们的密探发现坎诺公司在为泰琴德叛军提供补给时，我们的决定便再明确不过了。坎诺人被永远禁止进入我们的港口，舰队被派出来阻止坎诺人到达泰琴德海岸。不幸的是，坎诺人对古代精灵遗物的贪婪是如此之大，以至于很快就出现了走私者来满足他们的需求......

我们一直在与坎诺人斗争，他们企图摧毁我们的帝国来满足他们的贪婪。我们不会让他们的愿望实现，因为我们是先驱精灵遗产的继承者；我们不会让异族玷污它。
description.text_en:
At first there were few. A small group of ships, explorers from a faraway continent beyond Aelantir. But this trickle turned into a flood, as all sorts of foreign people of differing colors and sizes crowded our Taychendi ports, seeking to steal the valuable relics of our ancestors.

At first, they were tolerated. But soon, our local administrators placed restrictions on their movement and influence. Once our agents learned of Cannorian companies supplying Taychendi rebellions against us, the decision was clear. The Cannorians were barred from our ports for good and we sent our fleet to stop the Cannorians from ever reaching Taychendi shores. Unfortunately, the Cannorian greed for ancient elven relics was so great, that smugglers soon appeared to meet their demand…

We face a constant struggle against the Cannorians, who seek to bring down our empire to satisfy their greed. We will not let their wishes be realized for we are inheritors of the Precursor legacy; and we will not let the foreigners defile it.

description.text:
「征服者」拉斯卡里斯怀着传播文明开化的福祉的宏愿来到泰琴德，他的英勇行为将泰琴德人从习以为常的野蛮和军阀混战中拯救出来。自从他应预言而去世后，泰琴德遗迹精灵围绕着他和他的后代逐渐形成了一种崇拜，视其家族为神圣血脉。即使不认同拉斯卡里斯之血拥有神性的人，也崇尚拉斯卡里斯和他的后裔所拥护的原则：民粹主义。

拉斯卡里斯的后裔提壬狄瑞斯在拉斯卡里斯崇拜者和平民阶层的支持下崛起。他登上王位，宣称人民已经推选拉斯卡里斯的后裔为这片土地的统治者。在随后那些仍然相信共和哲学理想者的大规模叛乱被粉碎后，提壬狄瑞斯宣告为刻伊俄奈世界带来民粹主义和君主制的新时代。
description.text_en:
Laskaris the conqueror came to Taychend in a great effort to bring the benefits of civilization. His heroic actions saved them from the barbarity and warlordism they were so accustomed to. Since his prophesized passing, a cult grew around the worship of him and his descendants among the Taychendi, who see him and his bloodline as divine. And among those that did not see his bloodline as divine, they certainly venerated the principles Laskaris and his descendants would espouse: populism.

Thirendires, a descendant of Laskaris, would rise to power with the support of the Laskarian cult and the common people behind him. He ascended to kingship, proclaiming that the people have elected the bloodline of Laskaris as the rulers of these lands. The great rebellion that followed by those still believing in the philosophized ideal of a republic was crushed, and Thirendires proclaimed a new populist and Monarchist era for the world of the Kheionai.

description.text: 那居拉帝国进行的大型考古项目导致了古代先驱精灵建筑技术和风格重见天日，拉斯卡里斯王朝全心全意地接受了这些技术和风格，作为帝国的新的官方建筑风格。一场大规模的建筑狂潮随之而来，帝国各个地区的每座城市都不断有先驱精灵风格的建筑项目建成，旧的建筑也被翻新以仿效。
description.text_en: The large archeological program conducted by the Nákyran Empire led to the rediscovery of ancient Precursor building techniques and styles, which the Laskaris dynasty embraced wholeheartedly as the new official building style of the empire. A large building spree would ensue, with every city in every region of the empire having constant construction projects built in the precursor style and old buildings being renovated to emulate them.

description.text: 克莱雷延人是接受刻伊俄奈生活方式，文明开化的泰琴德遗迹精灵。即使如此，他们此前仍然没有被正当地接纳入阿墨翁政府。这种情况随着提壬狄瑞斯的登基而改变，因为克莱雷延人是他最忠诚的追随者。作为奖赏，他把克莱雷延人安插在行政部门中的最高层，给予特殊优待。在那居拉帝国的每一个地方，都可以找到克莱雷延人的身影，提壬狄瑞斯的继任者们继续执行这一政策，他们将克莱雷延人视为自己最忠诚的支持基础。
description.text_en: The Klereyen are the Taychendi that have embraced civizilation and the ways of the Kheionai. Even still, they were not properly integrated into the government of Ameion. This changed with the ascension of Thirendires to kingship, with the Klereyen as his most loyal followers. He rewarded them by putting them in the highest levels of administration and favoring them as such. In every part of the empire of Nákyra, the Klereyen can be found, a policy continued by Thirendires's successors, who saw the Klereyen as their most loyal base of support.

effects.display: 统治者同文化顾问花费：-15%
effects.label_zh: 统治者同文化顾问花费

description.text:
即使在战场上被打败后，许多刻伊俄奈人仍然坚持他们哲学化的共和理想。虽然他们中的许多人已经心灰意冷，无法继续抵抗，但更多的人拒绝承认并积极抵制一个事实：拉斯卡里斯的后裔才是这片土地的统治者。对君主制挥之不去的怨恨和偶尔的叛乱，导致那居拉需要创建一支新的部队，专门用来打击这种不断涌现的威胁。这支部队就是克律法耳珀丹，即隐蔽之盾。

他们从最忠诚的克莱雷延人中招募，积极追捕共和派抵抗势力。他们尤其活跃在德万和刻伊翁，是保护皇室和整个那居拉免受国内外攻击的盾牌。
description.text_en:
Even after their defeat on the field of battle, many Kheionai still cling to their philosophized ideal of a republic. While many among them are too disheartened to continue resistance, many more refuse to acknowledge, and actively resist the truth: the blood of Laskaris are the rulers of these lands. The lingering resentment and occasional rebellion against the monarchy has led to the need to create a new force designed specifically to combat this ever present threat: The Krypharpedan.

Recruited from amongst the most loyal of Klereyen, they actively hunt the republican resistance. Especially active in the Devand and in the kheions, they are the shield that keeps the royal family, and Nákyra as a whole, safe from both domestic and foreign attack.

description.text:
起初只有几艘船。一小队船只，是来自埃兰提尔以外遥远大陆的探险者。但是，涓涓细流变成了滔滔洪水，各种肤色和体型的异族人挤满了我们在泰琴德的港口，试图偷走我们祖先的珍贵文物。

起初，我们选择容忍。但很快，地方官员就开始对他们的行动和影响施加限制。当我们的密探发现坎诺公司在为泰琴德叛军提供补给时，我们的决定便再明确不过了。坎诺人被永远禁止进入我们的港口，舰队被派出来阻止坎诺人到达泰琴德海岸。不幸的是，坎诺人对古代精灵遗物的贪婪是如此之大，以至于很快就出现了走私者来满足他们的需求......

我们一直在与坎诺人斗争，他们企图摧毁我们的帝国来满足他们的贪婪。我们不会让他们的愿望实现，因为我们是先驱精灵遗产的继承者；我们不会让异族玷污它。
description.text_en:
At first there were few. A small group of ships, explorers from a faraway continent beyond Aelantir. But this trickle turned into a flood, as all sorts of foreign people of differing colors and sizes crowded our Taychendi ports, seeking to steal the valuable relics of our ancestors.

At first, they were tolerated. But soon, our local administrators placed restrictions on their movement and influence. Once our agents learned of Cannorian companies supplying Taychendi rebellions against us, the decision was clear. The Cannorians were barred from our ports for good and we sent our fleet to stop the Cannorians from ever reaching Taychendi shores. Unfortunately, the Cannorian greed for ancient elven relics was so great, that smugglers soon appeared to meet their demand…

We face a constant struggle against the Cannorians, who seek to bring down our empire to satisfy their greed. We will not let their wishes be realized for we are inheritors of the Precursor legacy; and we will not let the foreigners defile it.

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你厌恶时间压力、君主点紧缺、文化同化、长线多战场或帝国主义主角，请避开。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期依靠超级统治者高速征服，中期管理附庸、同化、城市与考古，后期多方向扩张并为G52—G00大陆内战储备财政、人力和堡垒。
player_overview.overview: 你是刻伊俄奈世界最东端的共和国，开局由命定死期前近乎不可战胜的拉斯卡里斯统治。前期必须高速征服泰琴德，中期把盟友、城邦和被征服者编入属国与凯奥奈化体系，同时投入资源发掘先驱遗迹；后期则向整个南艾兰提尔扩张，并在共和国与君主派撕裂帝国时选择阵营。它故事密集、机制多，但文明复兴背后是强制同化与高压统治。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢亚历山大式征服、强人物叙事、共和国政治、属国经营、考古和大型灾难的玩家。
signature_features: 拉斯卡里斯在预言死期前拥有强大战力，迫使玩家用连续战争把个人神话迅速变成国家基础。
共和国政治、自治城邦和附庸网络同凯奥奈化、军事移民与集中统治并存，扩张后的治理选择直接决定帝国形态。
先驱遗迹考古和塔塞尼搜索与后期大陆内战相接，让最强盛的帝国在终局重新为自身合法性而战。
player_overview.tagline: 追随知道自己死期的征服者，以共和国、军团、附庸和先驱遗迹，把破碎的南艾兰提尔压进一套无神帝国秩序。

reasons: 拉斯卡里斯的预言死期把强人物叙事直接变成前期节奏机制
征服后的附庸、自治、文化与宗教整合比普通涂色更有层次
考古与失落浮空城提供独立于战争的长期资源投入目标
后期G52—G00内战让帝国在最强盛时重新接受制度检验
warnings: 高速征服和复杂任务前置仍有明显时间表感
考古、科技、稳定和扩张同时争夺君主点
后期灾难会拆分版图和属国，盲玩容错较低
国家主线含强制同化、劳役和文明优越论

positive_indicators: 被征服者社会上升渠道
values.rationale: 凯奥奈化、文化宗教同化和帝国文明使命首先体现为偏单一社会；土地剥夺、劳役和强制改造继续降低价值分，但国家也提供城市建设、稳定、有限自治与上升通道，因此不再把帝国扩张本身重复计入邪恶。
